welcome: Hello, welcome to the Cambridge restaurant system! You can ask for restaurants by area, price range or food type. How may I help you?
askarea: What part of town do you have in mind?
askfoodtype: What kind of food would you like?
askpricerange: Which price range do you prefer?
confirmarea: I did not recognize {givenarea}. Did you mean {correctedarea}?
confirmfoodtype: I did not recognize {givenfoodtype}. Did you mean {correctedfoodtype}?
confirmpricerange: I did not recognize {givenpricerange}. Did you mean {correctedpricerange}?
recommend: I recommend {restaurantname}, a {pricerange} {food} restaurant in the {area} part of town.
recommendwithreasons: I recommend {restaurantname}, a {pricerange} {food} restaurant in the {area} part of town, because {reasons}.
alternative: How about {restaurantname}, a {pricerange} {food} restaurant in the {area} part of town?
alternativewithreasons: How about {restaurantname}, a {pricerange} {food} restaurant in the {area} part of town? It fits because {reasons}.
nomatch: I'm sorry, no restaurant matches your preferences.
noalternatives: I'm sorry, there are no other restaurants that match your preferences.
reasoncheapgoodfoodtouristic: it is cheap and has good food, which makes it touristic
reasonromaniannottouristic: it serves romanian food, which makes it not touristic
reasonbusyassignedseats: it is busy, so it has assigned seats
reasonlongstaynochildren: it allows a long stay, which makes it unsuitable for children
reasonbusynotromantic: it is busy, which makes it not romantic
reasonlongstayromantic: it allows a long stay, which makes it romantic
notunderstood: Sorry, I did not understand that. Could you please repeat that?
